observations: A single, very dark photo showing the rear and side profile of a television.
The deep, bulky plastic housing is characteristic of a CRT (Cathode Ray Tube) television.
No brand names, logos, or model stickers are legible in the photo.
The front screen is not visible.
The power cable is visible trailing from the back.

Internal electrical failures cannot be confirmed via external photos.

risks.risk: The screen (picture tube) is cracked or severely scratched.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the front of the television.

risks.risk: Internal copper or components have already been scavenged.
risks.proof: A photo of the back showing intact factory seals or screws.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the front of the TV to check the screen condition.
Photo of the manufacturer's label on the back for model and brand verification.
Photo of the unit in better lighting.
response.reason: The item is an obsolete CRT television that the seller explicitly states is non-functional. It is valued as scrap regardless of the specific internal fault.
